create.title: What would you like to create?

profile.title: Profile
profile.fontNote: “System” uses the font set on your device.
profile.previewNote: Preview at the real size of an item in a list.
profile.avatarHint: Without a photo, your initials show on your colour.
profile.avatarTooBig: That image is too heavy. Pick a smaller one.
profile.avatarFailed: That image could not be read.
profile.soundHint: A short beep when you tick, add or scan an item.
profile.hapticsHint: Haptic feedback on phones, when the device allows it.
profile.tourHint: Replay the guided tour of the main screens.
profile.householdHint: Invite your family and share your lists.
profile.adminHint: Approve new accounts and manage roles.

scan.failed: Cannot scan: allow the camera, or type the code in by hand.
scan.noCodeInImage: No code found in that image.
scan.imageFailed: That image could not be read.

cards.title: Cards
cards.secretNotice: Loyalty account passwords are never stored here.
cards.tapHint: Tap a card to show it full screen at the till.
cards.attachHint: A chain card works in every shop of that chain.
cards.name: Card name
cards.eanInvalid: This code is not a valid EAN-13.
cards.brightnessHint: Turn the screen brightness up so it scans easily.
cards.invalidCode: Unreadable code: it cannot be reproduced faithfully.

list.routeLearned: Sorted to match your route through this shop. Move the aisles to adjust it.
list.routeDefault: Default order. Move the aisles to teach your route through this shop.
list.empty: Nothing to show with these filters.
list.noItems: This list is empty. Add your first item.
list.priorityOnlyHint: Only the items marked as not to be forgotten.
list.hideCheckedHint: Hide what is already in the trolley.

share.title: Who can see this list?
share.note: Only the people ticked here see the list, its items and its chat.
share.alone: You are on your own in the household for now.

shops.title: Shops and aisles
shops.name: Shop name
shops.addressHint: The town is used to build the initials.
shops.geoDenied: Position unavailable. Allow location access, then try again.
shops.geoUnavailable: This device does not provide a position.

aisles.title: Aisles
aisles.name: Aisle name
aisles.hint: A new aisle is appended to every route — move it into place from the list.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.signInBody: Pick your lists back up, and your household's.
auth.signUpBody: It only takes a moment, and your settings come with you.
auth.mode: Sign in or create an account
auth.approvalNotice: Your account will need to be approved before you can use the app.
auth.signedUpBody: Check your inbox if a confirmation is requested, then sign in. Access opens once your account is approved.
auth.pendingBody: Your request has been recorded. Access opens once your account is approved.
auth.codeSent: A code is on its way to {email}.
auth.codeHint: Six digits. The email also holds a link, which works just as well.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.sizeBody: Nothing is final — you can change this any time in your profile.
welcome.sizeHint: Slide right to make it bigger.
welcome.lookBody: The screen changes right away. Keep whatever reads best.
welcome.accountBody: Your settings will follow you to your other devices.
welcome.langBody: Every language is written in its own script: look for yours.

tour.createBody: A list, an item, a shop, an aisle, a card: it all starts here.
tour.shopsBody: Order the aisles the way you actually walk them.
tour.magnifierBody: Read a label that is too small, using the camera.
tour.cardsBody: Loyalty cards, ready to show at the till.
tour.profileBody: Text size, colours, language, sharing with your family: it is all set here.
tour.listRouteBody: Take an aisle by its handle and move it: the app remembers the route you walk in this shop.
tour.listFiltersBody: Show only what matters, or hide what is already in the trolley. The dot means a filter is on.
tour.listShareBody: Send the list as it is to someone who does not have the app.
tour.listChatBody: A question asked from the aisle gets its answer here, without leaving the list.
tour.shopsAislesBody: Describe this shop's aisles once and your lists will sort themselves into them.
tour.cardsScanBody: With the camera, or from an image already on your device.
tour.magnifierZoomBody: Slide to enlarge the label as much as you need.
tour.magnifierFreezeBody: A still image reads better than a shaking hand. Tap again to resume.
tour.profileHouseholdBody: Invite the people you live with: your lists and shops become theirs too.

admin.title: Account approval
admin.demoReset: The demo household is back to its starting state.
admin.demoHint: The demo account is open to everyone. Reset it once it has been used a lot.

sync.offline: Offline — your changes will sync when the network is back

chat.title: Chat
chat.question: Question
chat.questionPlaceholder: What are we eating on Sunday?

household.title: My household
household.inviteHint: Create a code and give it to them. They type it into their own app.
household.joinHint: Enter the code you were given. Your current lists will be replaced by the ones in that household.
household.errorCode: This code is invalid or has expired. Ask the person inviting you for a new one.
household.errorSecondFactor: Enter your two-step verification code first.
household.errorNotApproved: Your account has not been approved yet.
household.errorLeaveFirst: Your current household has shopping or cards in it. Empty it, or get invited from another account.
household.errorLastMember: You are alone in this household: leaving would make it unreachable.
household.errorUnknown: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

magnifier.title: Magnifier
magnifier.denied: Camera access denied. Allow it in your settings to read a label up close.
magnifier.unsupported: The camera is not available here. The magnifier works on your phone.
magnifier.hint: Move closer to the label, then freeze the image to read at your own pace.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.body: Open your authenticator app and copy the code it shows.
mfa.wrong: That code does not match. The previous one may have expired.
mfa.lost: I no longer have my phone
mfa.backupBody: A backup code removes two-step verification from the account. You will set it up again from a device you still have.
mfa.backupHint: Ten characters, as they were given to you. Dashes and lower case are fine.
mfa.backupWrong: That code matches no unused backup code.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Your password, two-step verification, and the devices you are signed in on.
security.passwordBody: The old one is asked for again: without it, a screen left open would be enough to take the account.
security.twoFactorOff: Off. Once on, a code from your app will be asked for at every sign-in.
security.scan: Photograph this square with your authenticator app.
security.qrAlt: Square to photograph with an authenticator app
security.wrong: That code does not match. Check the time on your phone.
security.backupBody: Ten single-use codes. Each one removes two-step verification if you lose your phone.
security.backupWarning: Write them down now: they will never be shown again.
security.sessionsBody: Close what you do not recognise, or the tablet you lent out.

bugReport.success: Thanks, your report has been sent.

subtitle.bug: Describe what went wrong. A screenshot helps a lot.
subtitle.suggestion: Tell us what would help you, or what you'd like to see. A screenshot helps illustrate your idea.

descriptionPlaceholder.bug: What happened? What did you expect instead?
descriptionPlaceholder.suggestion: What would you like to see? How would it help?
